timeConvention: normalized time; a one-second scale gives corresponding rad/s and Hz

impulse_response.boundary: unit area, not unit height; impulse response describes zero-state behavior, with the impulse included across t=0

heaviside_expansion.boundary: simple-pole cover-up residues do not replace the repeated-pole derivative/expansion rule; causal inverse in its convergence region

sinusoid.boundary: frequency is not angular frequency; phase must use the same angular convention as the trigonometric argument

natural_response.boundary: distinguish zero-input decomposition from the homogeneous term relative to a chosen particular solution; total transient exp(-t) is not the zero-input term 3exp(-t)

convolution.boundary: convolution gives zero-state LTI response; nonzero initial state adds free response

step_input.boundary: input jumps at the switching time; this strictly proper plant output stays continuous for a finite step

typical_inputs.boundary: normalized ideal test signals; unit acceleration convention uses 0.5 t^2, not t^2

unit_impulse.boundary: Dirac is a distribution with unit area; a height-one pulse shrinking in width has area approaching zero

reference_input.boundary: reference is a desired output command, not necessarily actuator input or achieved output
